verdict.rationale: GitLab's docs say its REST API is described by an OpenAPI 3.0 spec that is autogenerated from the API code, and the raw spec (openapi_v2.yaml) is available in the GitLab monorepo for download. An interactive tool backed by it lets users browse and test every endpoint. Missing for 10: no dedicated documented download endpoint (the spec is fetched from the monorepo), no explicit statement that the spec covers the entire REST API, and no independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: GitLab documents its REST API using the OpenAPI 3.0 specification (formerly called Swagger)
The raw OpenAPI 3.0 specification is available in the GitLab monorepo
You can browse and test every endpoint interactively in the REST API documentation.
